stack_scope: One independently selectable patch; run only source.patch or alternative after-dot937.patch, not both. Alternative validated on exact source subset through #941 (includes #926 and #937). No whole-application build in this receipt.
scope: Strict historical JournalProjection before measurement; synchronous in-process projector no storage IPC. Equal distinct qualifying keys make observed insertion attempts unique in fixture. Counter and logical allocator layout live metric are separate from PSS. noparts is accepted durable input, not offered as a valid live provider output. Legacy source records and no command invocation.

reproduction.runner:
set -eu
here=$PWD
: "${PROTEUS_TEST_REFERENCE_MODULE:?point to the matching inert fixture executable}"
: "${PROTEUS_TEST_SESSION_STORAGE_MODULE:?point to the matching inert fixture executable}"
for arm in ${W337_ARMS:-stock owner}; do (
 cd "$arm"
 c=crates/proteus-core/src
 path=$c/app_server/transcript/journal/tests.rs
 source=$c/app_server/transcript/journal/source.rs
 for f in "$path" "$c/lib.rs" "$source"; do cp "$f" "$f.w337-backup"; done
 cp "$here/meter.rs" "$c/w337_alloc.rs"
 printf '\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod w337_alloc;\n' >> "$c/lib.rs"
 cat "$here/probe.rs" >> "$path"
 python3 "$here/instrument.py" "$source"
 cargo test --offline --locked --release -p proteus-core --lib --no-run -j 4 >"$here/$arm.build.log" 2>&1
 grep -F "($here/$arm/crates/proteus-core)" "$here/$arm.build.log"
 bin=$(sed -nE 's/.*Executable unittests src\/lib.rs \(([^)]+)\).*/\1/p' "$here/$arm.build.log")
 cp "$bin" "$here/$arm-tests"
 for f in "$path" "$c/lib.rs" "$source"; do mv "$f.w337-backup" "$f"; done
 rm "$c/w337_alloc.rs"
 cd crates/proteus-core
 mkdir -p "$here/$arm.wire"
 W337_WITNESS_DIR="$here/$arm.wire" "$here/$arm-tests" 'app_server::transcript::' --test-threads=1 --nocapture >"$here/$arm.test.log" 2>&1
 "$here/$arm-tests" 'app_server::http::tests::' --test-threads=1 --nocapture >"$here/$arm.api.log" 2>&1
); done
reproduction.test_hook:
from pathlib import Path
import sys
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
s=p.read_text()
needle='                        visibility.workflow_root_calls.insert(tool.call.id.clone());'
if s.count(needle)==0:
    needle='                        workflow_root_calls.insert(tool.call.id.clone());'
assert s.count(needle)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(needle,'                        #[cfg(test)]\n                        crate::w337_alloc::witness_insert();\n'+needle))
reproduction.runner_environment: Supply the matching local inert reference and session-storage fixtures from the existing Core test setup to the runner. For combined run initialize exact two stated commit trees in joined-stock and joined-owner worktree, then set W337_ARMS to joined-stock joined-owner. The libs and projectors are not releases.
